games.name: [GREAT SWAMPS UPDATE] Zone STALKER [Pre Alpha]
games.desc:
Enter the Zone.

Zone STALKER is a hardcore atmospheric extraction survival game inspired by the legendary STALKER series. Scavenge abandoned industrial ruins, survive deadly anomalies, hunt mutants, and fight hostile factions across a dangerous open world consumed by the Zone.

Every expedition is a risk. Build your loadout, manage your supplies, complete tasks, and extract with your loot before the Zone takes everything from you.

Travel alone or with up to 4 players in online co-op through dark forests, abandoned checkpoints, underground facilities, and radioactive wastelands where every gunshot echoes danger.

Features:
• Persistent character saving & progression
• Personal stash system
• Hardcore loot loss & extraction gameplay
• Dynamic anomalies, emissions, and atmospheric events
• AI factions, mutants, and random encounters
• Randomly generated Task.
• Detailed inventory & gear management system
• Squad-based co-op survival

(PRE-ALPHA) Expect bugs, wipes, and missing features!

games.name: Playbreak
games.desc:
This is a 1v6 asymmetrical game heavily inspired by "Project: Playtime", but with a few additions and improvements of its own, aiming to become more original over time.
Please note that this game is in BETA, nothing is final, and it should not be treated as such.
If you love the game, it'll get even better, we are currently working on the FULL release!
The entire game will be recoded, new mechanics will come, and much more!
- HOW TO PLAY -
Specialists must complete puzzles, collect toy parts, and help each other escape.
The monster must try to stop the Specialists from completing their tasks by downing them and throwing them into the feeding pit.

- IMPORTANT -
All rights belong to Mob Entertainment for their respective items, models, rigs, characters, sounds, music, and animations. I do not own them. Please support Mob Entertainment before anything else.
If you have any copyright concerns, feel free to message me, and I will gladly remove any content from the game as soon as possible.

games.name: [🖼️ MUSEUM] Chameleon
games.desc:
🎨 CHAMELEON

Blend in. Paint yourself. Trick the seekers.

Chameleon is a hide and seek painting game inspired by Meccha Chameleon, where hiders use colors, brushes, and smart camouflage to survive while seekers hunt them down with abilities.

Paint your character to match the map, hide in plain sight, use taunts, freeze in place, and outplay the seekers before time runs out.

Join our group for updates, rewards, codes, testing access, and future content drops.

Controls:
B Brush
G Fill
C Color Picker
Q Undo
E Redo
F Freeze
T Taunt
R Abilities
